text: The presentation by Equity Consultant, Equity and Human Rights Section, People and Equity Division, will outline the purpose of the Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Trans, Queer Advisory Committee and will provide an overview the previous term’s decision and of the development of the work plan and priorities for this term.
Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee received this item for information.
